name: presence-detector
description: Skill for detecting whether the user is present at or away from their macOS machine

interface.shortDescription: Detect whether the user is at their macOS machine.
interface.longDescription: Presence Detector provides a skill that combines screen lock, screensaver, input idle time, and Focus mode into a single present/away verdict for macOS, suitable for presence-gating automations.
defaultPrompt: Am I currently at my machine?
